name: OrcaVault MCP
description: Permanent on-chain memory storage for AI agents. An agent pays 2 LCAI once (native Lightchain) to the relay payment address and its content is stored forever on Lightchain, with a verifiable on-chain record of exactly what was stored and by whom. Not a per-upload fee.

payment.note: One-time unlock via /api/register-payment after native LCAI transfer to payment address

paymentOptions.note: One-time unlock via /api/register-payment after native LCAI transfer to payment address

Ethereum-side agents can pay in USDC bridged to Lightchain via the Hyperlane warp route, then call /api/register-payment with the token transfer tx hash. Activates once the USDC warp route is deployed and tokenAddress is published.
